info.name: Fusionlabs Offers API
info.description: GraphQL endpoint for the offers resolver. Set the `userId` collection variable to authenticate (sent as `x-user-id`). Default user is `u1` (VIP at merchant m2 in the seed).

request.description: Run once, then copy `pagination.nextCursor` into `page.cursor` and run again to fetch the next page.
Expected: errors[].message contains the GqlError 'Unauthorized' (returned as INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR by Yoga in dev).
User has no CustomerType rows — should still see 'All'-eligible cashback at Java House but NOT the VIP-only ExclusiveOffer at Naivas.
Open this URL in a browser to use the built-in GraphiQL playground. Set the header tab to `x-user-id: u1` to authenticate.
